The '''T-990 Mk. II turbofan''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Podracer engine/Legends|engine]] produced by [[Balta-Trabaat/Legends|Balta-Trabaat]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. A [[Turbofan/Legends|turbofan]] engine, it was known for its afterburning effect. T-990 Mk. II turbofan was used in the [[BT310 Quadra/Legends|BT310 Quadra podracer]].
